dedupe_keys.name: sdg indicator 11 2 1 urban access to public transport 2023 release sedac

description: Part of SEDAC's SDG indicators collection, this data set provides tables of SDG indicator 11.2.1, the proportion of a city's population with convenient access to public transport, for 5,749 urban centres in 178 countries. Access is computed as the share of WorldPop gridded population within 0.5 km walking distance of a low-capacity public transport point or 1 km of a high-capacity point, both taken from OpenStreetMap, with cities delineated by the European Commission Joint Research Centre's Urban Centre Database. It responds to the UN finding that only about half the world's urban population has convenient access to public transport. Coverage is global for urban centres. Access: free CSV, geodatabase and shapefile downloads on Harvard Dataverse under CC BY 4.0, released September 2025, and a feature service in the Esri Living Atlas published by NASA Earthdata. Caveats: results depend on the completeness of OpenStreetMap stop mapping, which varies widely between countries, and walking distances simplify real access. The indicator supports accessibility and equity analyses of public transport, exposure studies of transit-dependent populations and benchmarking of service coverage. It complements the Rural Access Index release and the Mobility Database catalogued here.
